svg.title: Five Checks Before You Value What You Own
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-01-ownership-math-before-any-offer; chapter number: 1; title: Five Checks Before You Value What You Own; subtitle: Sum checks, NRA conversion, royalty-rate questions, live-lease proof, economic-life pricing; chart type: process_flow; stages: step: 01; label: Reconcile every owner decimal; value: Step 1; detail: Ann plus Bob plus Carl has to equal the lease royalty on every tract. If the sum misses, go back to the deeds.; step: 02; label: Convert the offer to dollars per NRA; value: Step 2; detail: 16 NMA under a 25% royalty converts to 32 NRA, so a $6,000/NMA offer ($96,000 total) is only $3,000/NRA.; step: 03; label: Ask which royalty rate the buyer assumed; value: Step 3; detail: On unleased minerals, if the going rate is 15-20% against the buyer's 12.5%, there is negotiation room.; step: 04; label: Confirm the lease is alive; value: Step 4; detail: An ORRI dies with the lease. Confirm the lease is held and the wells are economic before paying, and add washout protection to any assignment.; step: 05; label: Price to remaining economic life; value: Step 5; detail: Review declines, reserves, operators, rights and lease terms. On an old single well, value the override on existing production only.; caption: Street math runs on net mineral acres, the royalty decimal and net royalty acres. A headline per-NMA offer can halve once normalized to the 1/8 standard.; assumptions note: All figures are the speakers' own worked examples. The 16 NMA, 25% royalty and $6,000/NMA offer come from a single Matt Sands illustration and are not market quotes.; note: Attributed to LMJ Land Services (IBxLIQjDNto), Matt Sands (iVFjOPF8JW0, pjmqehPUgL8), Blue Mesa Minerals (PR8LyKmo8S4) and PetroPeak Investments LLC (zHSS1bvXiNk) on YouTube.

text.title: Five Checks Before You Value What You Own
text.tspan: Five Checks Before You Value What You Own

circle.title: step: 01; label: Reconcile every owner decimal; value: Step 1; detail: Ann plus Bob plus Carl has to equal the lease royalty on every tract. If the sum misses, go back to the deeds.

text.title: Ann plus Bob plus Carl has to equal the lease royalty on every tract. If the sum misses, go back to the deeds.
text.tspan: Ann plus Bob plus Carl has to equal…

circle.title: step: 02; label: Convert the offer to dollars per NRA; value: Step 2; detail: 16 NMA under a 25% royalty converts to 32 NRA, so a $6,000/NMA offer ($96,000 total) is only $3,000/NRA.

text.title: Convert the offer to dollars per NRA
16 NMA under a 25% royalty converts to 32 NRA, so a $6,000/NMA offer ($96,000 total) is only $3,000/NRA.

circle.title: step: 03; label: Ask which royalty rate the buyer assumed; value: Step 3; detail: On unleased minerals, if the going rate is 15-20% against the buyer's 12.5%, there is negotiation room.

text.title: Ask which royalty rate the buyer assumed
On unleased minerals, if the going rate is 15-20% against the buyer's 12.5%, there is negotiation room.

circle.title: step: 04; label: Confirm the lease is alive; value: Step 4; detail: An ORRI dies with the lease. Confirm the lease is held and the wells are economic before paying, and add washout protection to any assignment.

text.title: An ORRI dies with the lease. Confirm the lease is held and the wells are economic before paying, and add washout protection to any assignment.
text.tspan: An ORRI dies with the lease. Confirm…

circle.title: step: 05; label: Price to remaining economic life; value: Step 5; detail: Review declines, reserves, operators, rights and lease terms. On an old single well, value the override on existing production only.

text.title: Review declines, reserves, operators, rights and lease terms. On an old single well, value the override on existing production only.
Assumptions: All figures are the speakers' own worked examples. The 16 NMA, 25% royalty and $6,000/NMA offer come from a single Matt Sands illustration and are not market quotes.
